title: Jair Bolsonaro taken to hospital over abdominal pain
detail: Former president Jair Bolsonaro was taken to hospital with abdominal pain, per DW. Based on a single report; his condition and diagnosis are not confirmed here.

title: Jair Bolsonaro admitted to intensive care with acute bowel obstruction
detail: Former president Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to intensive care with an acute bowel obstruction, per Al Jazeera. This follows his earlier hospitalization for abdominal pain the same day. Based on a single report.
